steps.observation: You have 30 seconds. How does a transformer neural network work, conceptually?

steps.action:
A transformer works in three big steps, all without recurrence:

1. Input & Positional Encoding  
   • Each token is turned into an embedding vector.  
   • A positional encoding is added so the model knows word order.

2. Multi-Head Self-Attention  
   • For every token you compute Queries (Q), Keys (K) and Values (V).  
   • Attention scores = softmax(Q · Kᵀ/√d) tell you how much each token “pays attention” to every other.  
   • You multiply those scores by V to get context-aware representations.  
   • Multiple heads let you attend to different types of relationships in parallel.

3. Feed-Forward + Residuals + Norm  
   • Each attention output goes through a small feed-forward network.  
   • Add residual connections and layer normalization for stability.

Stacking N of these layers lets the model learn deep, global dependencies in a sequence.
